name: pm-decisions
description: Fast, typed product-management decisions backed by TypeSafe's Jev: feedback triage, duplicate detection, story readiness, risk flags, priority scoring, status reading, meeting-note labelling, release-note classification, and a sensitive-content check before sharing. Claude writes; Jev decides.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key from console.typesafe.ai. Leave empty to run in offline mock mode (keyword heuristics, for demos only).

config_path.title: Config file (optional)
config_path.description: Absolute path to your own pm-decisions YAML config (product areas, gates, weights). Leave empty for defaults.
